payload.core_mechanism_summary: Find first and last 0 and 1; compute spans; if min span < k, first wins; if any span > k, draw; else if contiguous run >= k exists, draw else second wins.
payload.rationale: Solution uses a direct property-based decision derived from optimal play analysis, which relies on exchange argument: first player can force win if a small span exists, else second can force draw given long runs.
